body:
# Vanilla Enhanced

**Vanilla Enhanced** is a carefully curated Fabric modpack for **Minecraft 1.21.8**, designed to improve performance, visuals, and quality of life without changing core vanilla gameplay.

This modpack is built for players who enjoy the original Minecraft experience but want it to feel smoother, more modern, and more immersive.

---

## ✨ Key Features

### ⚡ Performance & Stability
- Major optimizations using **Sodium, Lithium, FerriteCore, ModernFix, Krypton, ImmediatelyFast**, and **Entity Culling**
- Improved FPS, reduced memory usage, and faster world loading
- Optimized to work smoothly with shaders enabled

### 🎨 Visual Enhancements
- Shader support via **Iris** (tested with Complementary Shaders)
- Improved animations and models with **Fresh Animations**, **3D Skin Layers**, **Entity Model Features**, and **Entity Texture Features**
- Enhanced particles, dynamic lighting, skyboxes, and subtle ambient effects
- Improved item, block, entity, and GUI visuals while preserving the vanilla art style

### 🧭 Quality of Life
- Enhanced HUD and UI elements (status bars, tooltips, advancements, statistics)
- Improved inventory, enchanting, anvils, shulkers, and crafting interactions
- Navigation and world tools such as **Xaero’s Minimap & World Map** and **Bobby**
- Optional features including zoom, replay recording, dynamic crosshair, chat improvements, and controller support

### 🌐 Multiplayer & Utility
- Fully client-side and safe to use on multiplayer servers
- Built-in proximity voice chat support (**Simple Voice Chat**)
- No gameplay-altering mechanics or unfair advantages

---

## 🎯 Who Is This Modpack For?

- Players who want **vanilla Minecraft — just better**
- Users looking for **high performance with modern visuals**
- Those who prefer **client-side improvements only**
- Suitable for survival, creative, and multiplayer gameplay

---

## ❌ What This Modpack Does *Not* Add

- No new dimensions, mobs, ores, or progression systems
- No changes to vanilla balance or core mechanics
- No server-side requirements

Every change in **Vanilla Enhanced** focuses on improving how Minecraft *feels*, while keeping gameplay authentic and familiar.
